scope: Complete32-cell first-setting inventory;19literal figures transcribed for instrumental study. Thirteen cells retain explicit notation/application or incomplete-transcription gaps. No arbitrary-word fitting is supplied.
timing: Written note/rest values at an independently chosen quarter-note tempo. Printed recitative/bar separators do not impose inferred measure counts, breaths or expressive durations. Source leading, interior, dotted and final rests are retained. Two newly retained fermatas have unspecified hold lengths; instrumental playback uses their written values, without an inferred extension.

applicationIssue.status: Preserve both source and reader. Do not infer component-to-word alignment from horizontal heading order.

limits: Source figures only. No complete contextual melody system, regional identity for 1.W., Kinnor equivalence, pronunciation transformation, Hebrew syllable fitting or new singing voice is asserted. Existing text, accents, notes, source audio and timing data remain unchanged.
